text: Lieutenant Rulon Raymond is a character who appears in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare and member of the Settlement Defense Front. He's assigned to the SetDef carrier SDS Hellas. Raymond is killed by Nick Reyes during Operation D-Con.
Private First Class Robert Zussman is the deuteragonist in Call of Duty: WWII. He is the best friend of the protagonist Ronald "Red" Daniels.
Corporal Ronald Daniels, also known as Red, is the protagonist of Call of Duty: WWII. He also appears in Call of Duty: Heroes.

Captain Rover Joe is a character featured in Call of Duty: WWII. He is an United States Army Air Force command personnel, who relays 1st Infantry Division request for close air support from Matthew Weber's 509th Fighter Squadron during the Battle of the Bulge.

Private Robbins is a British soldier appearing in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. During World War II, Robbins served with Popski's Private Army and with them participated in numerous raids on German targets in Tunisia.

Rosa is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile, introduced in the Season 3: Tokyo Escape Comics and was released as a playable character on June 11, 2021, during Season 4: Spurned & Burned as part of the Drillhead Draw.

Rott is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on August 6, 2021, during Season 6: The Heat as part of the Rottweiler Draw. Rott also plays a minor role in the Battle Pass comics, as a minor antagonist.

Roland Zeimet is an Operator of the Barbarian faction featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard and Call of Duty: Warzone. Roland Zeimet appears in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added on December 7th, 2023, as part of the Season 11: Siren Song Battle Pass.

Lieutenant Robert Jacobs is a minor character featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard. He is a British officer in command of Lucas Riggs' demolitions team and unlike his fellow countrymen, treats his Australian comrades with respect.

Rin Yoshida is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile, introduced in the Season 8: Error 404 Comics and was released as a playable character on December 31st, 2023, with Season 11: Siren Song as part of the Severed Words Draw.
Sergeant Salvatore Guzzo was an Italian-American radioman who fought during World War II in the United States Army. Guzzo is seen in Call of Duty 3.
Private Saadak was a Red Army soldier who fought during World War II in the Battle of Stalingrad, as seen in Call of Duty: Finest Hour.

Corporal Samson was a character in Call of Duty 2 who replaced Cpl. Maxwell when he died. When the player links up with Cpt. Price and Pvt. MacGregor, Samson dies when blowing up German fuel and ammunition. It is impossible to save him.

Lieutenant Sasha Vidov (Russian: Саша Видов) is a Red Army officer who participated in the Operation Little Saturn attack on the German-held airfield of Tatsinskaya, as seen in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. After the main airstrip was taken by Russian armor, Vidov reported via radio that more men would be needed to take the isolated German communications tower.

The SIS Chief is the leader of the MI6 intelligence. He is heard in the game Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3. He is heard in the cutscene, "Mind the Gap", telling the MI6 to alert the MI5 Director to inform them of the immediate threat.

Doctor Samantha Cross was a character in Call of Duty: Ghosts and one of the primary characters and the main antagonist of the Extinction saga. She is a doctor in paleolinguistics and a former member of the Nightfall Program, where she studied the origins of the Cryptids. She also made a minor appearance in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare in the Zombies map The Beast From Beyond.

Samuel Abidoyo is a character in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare, and the Prime Minister of Nigeria. He appears in the level "Traffic", and was taken hostage by Hades while attending an international technology summit in Lagos. He is later rescued by Jack Mitchell, Gideon, Joker, and Ajani.
Santiago Hernandez, also known as Beast, is a character featured in Call of Duty Online and one of three default characters that are initially unlocked, alongside Yuri and Andrea.

Admiral Salen Kotch is a character featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, serving as the main antagonist. He is an Admiral in the Settlement Defense Front and commander of the SDF's 8th Orbital Fleet, and its flagship the SDS Olympus Mons supercarrier, the largest warship ever built.
Sally Octavia Simpson is a playable character featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare Zombies. She is voiced by Sasheer Zamata.

Lieutenant Sang Yup Kim is a character who appears in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare and member of the Settlement Defense Front. He's assigned to the SetDef Destroyer SDS Argas. Kim is killed in the explosion of the Argas destroyed by Nick Reyes during Operation Grave Robber.
Commander Samantha Foxwell is a character in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. Foxwell is the leader of the Sabre Team Seven private military group.

Oberst Sauer is a character in Call of Duty: WWII. He is an officer wearing grey uniform. He is busy working in the room next to Karl Fischer. The player assumes control of Camille "Rousseau" Denis and can interact with him, asking him is he Fischer or telling him the code phrase "Verlaine". If the player tells him the code phrase, he will ask Rousseau to give him her ID papers and ask her why she has come here. If she responds "inventory reports" instead of "travel documents" she will be arrested, resulting in a game-over screen. He is later killed by the French Resistance when they entered the garrison after Rousseau blow up the entrances.

Sergeant Sasserov is a member of the Red Army in Call of Duty: United Offensive. After the German soldiers were forced out the village, Sasserov makes his speech while standing on a T-34 tank holding a PPSh-41.
Sahora is a minor character in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. He was killed during Operation Blood Storm.
Sam Davis is a character featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard. He is in command of during The Battle of Midway.

SCAR 2-1 is a character featured in the Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare campaign and in its PS4-exclusive Jackal Assault VR Experience. They are a member of the Special Combat Air Recon and under the command of SCAR 1-2.

SCAR 1-2 is a character featured in the Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare campaign and in its PS4-exclusive Jackal Assault VR Experience. She is in command of SCAR 2-1 as well as being a member of the Special Combat Air Recon.
Sabine Mosier, also known as Nyx or Night, is a character featured in Call of Duty Online.

Corporal Scott Riley is an Non-Commissioned Officer in the 101st Airborne Division, 506th Parachute Infantry Regiment, Baker company, and is playable in the American campaign of Call of Duty: United Offensive.
Private Saunders was an American soldier in Fox Company who fought and died in World War II under the command of Glenn Hawkins. He is seen only in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One.
Comissar Sergei Konstantinov (Russian: Сергей Константинов) is a Russian soldier that can be seen in "Defend the Factory" in Call of Duty: Finest Hour.
The Secretary is a character featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops II, who only appeared in the mission Cordis Die.
Sergeant is a character appearing in Call of Duty Online, in the Cyborg Rising, Cyborg Evacuation and Deus Ex game mode.

Sergeant Sean Brooks is a character in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. As a SATO Marine abroad the UNSA Retribution, Brooks played a major role during the UNSA-SDF War, and was ultimately amongst the four survivors of the Retribution following the end of the war.

Lieutenant Sergio Gil is a character who appears in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare and member of the Settlement Defense Front. He's assigned to the SetDef warship SDS AFB Titan Bravo. Gil is killed by Nick Reyes in a dogfight during Operation Sudden Death.

Private Senn is a British soldier appearing in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. During World War II, Senn served with Popski's Private Army and with them participated in numerous raids on German targets in Tunisia.
Scylla is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on September 13th, 2020, during Season 10 The Hunt as part of Natural Causes Draw.

Sipes is a character appearing in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare in the mission "Rising Threat". He appears alongside Dan "Wolf" Lyall and Tee. He tries to get to Wolf but is captured by SDF forces and killed, when his head was crushed by the foot of one of the robots.
Simons is a character mentioned in Call of Duty 2. He served in the 7th Armoured Division, seeing action in North Africa.

Private Short is a British soldier appearing in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. During World War II, Short served with Popski's Private Army and with them participated in numerous raids on Nazi targets in Tunisia.
Siren is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on October 2nd, 2020, during Season 10: The Hunt as part of Cybernetic Stalker Draw. Siren also appears in the comics.
Shadow-1 TV Operator is a playable character featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II. He is a member of Shadow Company and in control of the AC-130's TV Operations.
The Skeleton King is an enemy boss featured in the Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War Zombies mode, being featured in Dead Ops Arcade 3: Rise of the Mamaback, found in The Wild.
Private Simon was an American soldier in Fox Company who fought and died in World War II.
Sergeant Snider was a member of the United States Marine Corps during World War II, in Call of Duty: World at War.
Private Sonntag is a character featured in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. He was an American soldier assigned to Able Company that fought in World War II at the Battle of Remagen.
Snowman is a member of Bravo 9 and is a playable character and the secondary protagonist in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare (Nintendo DS).
Private Spirduso is a character that appears in the mission "Into the Jungle". He is sent by the squad to scout the area, but is soon ambushed and killed by a Japanese grenade.
Spade Q, known as the Queen of Spades, is a character featured in Call of Duty Online.

Private Smart is a British soldier appearing in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. During World War II, Smart served with Popski's Private Army and with them participated in numerous raids on German targets in Tunisia.

The Smuggler (also known as the unlockable character Necromedic) is a character involved in the main quest of the Nazi Zombies map The Shadowed Throne in Call of Duty: WWII. He is a black market smuggler contacted by the Raven team of the MFAA during the Battle of Berlin. He is part of the "Fieldwork" challenge set for The Shadowed Throne.
Private Sofia Del Toro, better known as the Hunter is a character within Call of Duty: WWII Zombies and member of the Bureau of Archaic Technologies.

Sliver is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile, first introduced in the Season 10: Shadows Return comics, and later added as a playable character in the game on January 13th, 2022, during Season 11: Final Snow as part of the Dusk Owl Draw.

Sophia Couteau is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on June 30, 2022 as part of the Season 6: To The Skies Battle Pass. Sophia is the daughter of Templar. Prior to her release as a playable character, Sophia was mentioned multiple times by her father in the Comics. She appears as a child in the Season 11: Final Snow Comics, and later as an adult in Season 6: To the Skies comics.

Sparrowhawk is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on September 1st, 2022, during Season 7: New Vision City as part of the Moonlit Dagger Draw. Sparrowhawk also appears in the Comics.

Sergeant So Jae-Woo (Korean: 소재우), also known as Jae, is a character featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. He is a South Korean Marine. Jae is also set to appear as a playable Operator in Modern Warfare 4 and Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0.
Special Ops 1 is a playable character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile. He was available at launch and serves as a reoccurring character in media and missions representing the player.
Sergeant Stephen "Professor" Kelly is an American soldier who fought in World War II. Stephen Kelly was one of the supporting characters in the game Call of Duty 2: Big Red One.
Captain Stavro is an American engineer seen in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One. He is encountered on Omaha Beach during the mission "The Great Crusade.
Code name Stinger is a US Air Force pilot who appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance.
The Squadmate is a friendly N.P.C. featured in Call of Duty: Ghosts that aids the players when called in Safeguard.

Stansfield is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile, introduced in the Season 13 Wint3r War Comics and was released as a playable character on November 18, 2021, with Season 10: Shadows Return as part of the Battle Pass.

The Sturmkrieger (German: Stormwarrior) is a type of enemy in Call of Duty: Vanguard Zombies. It was introduced in Der Anfang. A powerful variant of the Strumkrieger called Uberkrieger (German: Superwarrior) can be encountered in The Archon during its main quest. This variant appears more reddish than the standard Sturmkrieger.

Lieutenant Tanya Pavelovna (Russian: Таня Павeловна) was a female soldier in Call of Duty: Finest Hour who fought for the Soviet Union during World War II. She is the first playable female character in the whole series.
Private Tchernovkov (Russian: Черновков) was a Red Army soldier who fought in the Battle of Stalingrad in World War II. He is featured in Call of Duty: Finest Hour.
Corporal Taylor is a British soldier in Call of Duty: World at War: Final Fronts. He was part of Tom Sharpe and Maddock's squad. He was first seen in The Relief of Bastogne.

Senior Lieutenant Suresh Malakar is a character who appears in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare and member of the Settlement Defense Front. He is assigned to the carrier SDS Centauri. Malakar is killed by Nick Reyes in a dogfight during Operation Trace Kill; although if the player doesn't authorise Operation Trace Kill, he will be presumed alive.
Private Taggart is a character that appears in Call of Duty: WWII.
The Swamp Creature is a boss featured in Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0 during The Haunting event.
Taoxia is a boss enemy within the Zombies mode of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III featured in the map, Operation Deadbolt. It serves as the final boss of the Union story mission, featured in Act IV.
Sutherland was an 8th Air Force airman featured in Call of Duty: Roads to Victory.
Private Telinov (Russian: Телинов) was a Red Army soldier of World War II who fought in the Battle of Stalingrad, and is seen in Call of Duty: Finest Hour.
The Technologist is a character featured in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare.

Tee is a character appearing in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare in the mission Rising Threat. He appears alongside Dan "Wolf" Lyall and Sipes. He was stomped to death by an SDF robot after Salen Kotch orders the SCAR team to be executed.

Tengu is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game as part of the Season 9 Conquest update. He could be obtained for free in the Ranked Series 6 "Undead Crusade" at Master II in Battle Royale.

The Butcher is a Zombie that features in Call of Duty: Mobile, appearing in the Battle Royale mode as a Boss encounter as a replacement for Cerberus. It also appears in Undead Siege in Hard Mode as a boss fight.
The Marshal is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on February 23rd, 2023 as part of the Season 2: Heavy Metal Battle Pass. The Marshal also appears in the Comics.

Templar's Shadow is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on May 25th, 2023 during Season 4: Veiled Uprising as part of the Bloody Skies Draw. Templar's Shadow also appears in the Comics.
The Iron Monk is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on September 7th, 2023 as part of the Season 8: ERROR 404 Battle Pass.
The Dark Heart is an enemy featured as the main boss in the Zombies map Paradox Junction in Call of Duty: Black Ops 7.

The Archer is the main antagonist of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. He is the Defense Minister of Russia aligned with the Ultranationalists and the Konni Group PMC. He is also the father of Vladimir Makarov.
Sergeant Thomas "Tom" Sullivan was an American squad leader of the United States Marine Corps in Call of Duty: World at War during World War II, and a major character in the first two missions.
Private Tom Sharpe is one of the main characters in Call of Duty: World at War Final Fronts. He fought for the 6th Airborne Division and was primarily a sniper.
Private Thorne was a British soldier featured in Call of Duty. He appears in the level, Pegasus Bridge-Day where he is seen fighting to hold Pegasus Bridge alongside Cpt. Price and Sgt. Evans.
Corporal Todd Gessinger is a Canadian soldier serving with the North Shore (New Brunswick) Regiment and he is featured in Call of Duty: Roads to Victory.

The n00b is a character in The Vet & The n00b. His weapons are the M4A1 with ACOG Scope and the M203 Grenade Launcher, SCAR-L with ACOG Scope, the M60E4, a RPG-7, and a Suppressed P99 with M67 Grenades and a Throwing Knife and was taught by The Vet how to fight. He is portrayed by .

Captain Thomas A. Merrick is a main character in Call of Duty: Ghosts. A Navy SEAL before the ODIN strikes caused by the Federation, Captain Merrick is the field commander for the Ghosts in 2028, and later becomes the Commanding Officer after his Captain's death in Las Vegas. He led soldiers during the final battles of the Federation War.

Tiny Man is a character in Call of Duty Online. He was in the tutorial level, and instructed the player when they first picked-up their M4A1 and UP-T45. He is effectively the equivalent of Gaz from Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare.
Private First Class Todd Kashima was a character in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare, a SATO Marine from Northern Canada who served under Omar.
Corporal Thomas "Tommy" Jones is a character featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard.

Thomas Bolt is an Operator of the Yeti faction featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard and Call of Duty: Warzone. Thomas was released during the Season Two content for Vanguard on February 27th, 2022 as part of the "Thomas Bolt Operator Bundle". Thomas Bolt appears in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added on December 22nd, 2023, during Season 11: Siren Song as part of the Chill Factor Strongbox.

Togusa is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on August 4th, 2022 as part of the Season 7: New Vision City. Togusa can be acquired for free by playing the Togusa's Survey event from August 4th until September 4th, 2022.

Tiangu is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on February 10th, 2023, during Season 1: Awakening as part of the Opera Assassin Draw. Tiangu also appears in the comics.

Mark William Calaway, better known as , is an American . The Undertaker is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was released on October 2nd, 2025 during Season 9: Midnight Rumble as part of the Undertaker Draw.
Private Twohill was an American Paratrooper under the command of Cpt. James who fought in the Sicilian campaign during World War II.
Sergeant Trascall is a British S.F.S.G. troop who appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance.
Sergeant Trent is a US National Guard, and a playable character who appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance.
Sergeant Travis is a US National Guard who appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance.
Tori Holder is a character featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. She is the Communications Officer aboard the Retribution. She was killed in action moments after landing in the SDF base.
Major V. S. Zubov (Russian: В. С. Зубов) was a Soviet Red Army soldier who was one of the commanders of soldiers launching the counterattacks on Stalingrad.

An Unknown Federation Soldier is a character in Call of Duty: Ghosts. This unnamed character appears in the audio file for the level Clockwork, where he is talking with Gabriel T. Rorke. After failing to prevent the Ghosts from infiltrating the base, Rorke says that if "you fail to protect your brothers, you join them in death." The character is presumably killed by Rorke.

The Unnamed Instructor is a character appearing in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2: Force Recon. He gives advice to the player, most especially in Base Camp, where he gives a complete tutorial of controls for the player.

Urban Tracker is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added into the game as part of the Season 4 Disavowed Battle Pass. Urban Tracker also appears in the comics and is the protagonist in Operation Spiderweb.

Vagr Modir is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on May 23rd, 2021, during Season 3: Tokyo Escape as part of Fallen Valkyrie Draw. Later, during Season 4: Spurned & Burned, Vagr was introduced in the Comics.
Umar Obi is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile. He was added in the game on February 20th, 2025 as part of the Season 2: Digital Dawn Battle Pass.
An Unnamed British Paratrooper was a minor character featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard.

The Unnamed North Korean Soldier, referred to simply as Comrade, is one of the playable characters featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. He is a soldier of the Korean People's army, under the command of Commander Ri Ju-Young and Lieutenant Ko Jin-Hyuk.
Private Victor "Vic" Denley was an American soldier who fought in World War II. Victor Denley is one of the supporting characters in the game Call of Duty 2: Big Red One.

Private Vasili Ivanovich Koslov (Russian: Василий Иванович Козлов) was a soldier in the Red Army who fought during World War II, and is a playable character featured in the Soviet campaign in Call of Duty 2.
Corporal Vassili Kulikov (Russian: Василий Куликов) was a soldier who fought in World War II in the Red Army.

Commissar Viktor Durasov (Russian: Виктор Дурасов) is a Russian soldier appearing in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. During the Second World War, he served with the Red Army and participated in the Battle of Stalingrad.

Van Dyke was one of the men in the Dutch Resistance group along with De Leeuw, Goriss, Janssen, Smits and Van de Berg. They saved James Doyle after his B-17 Flying Fortress had been shot down over the Netherlands, their leader being Major Ingram (it is unclear whether Ingram was already a commanding officer of the SAS by the time of this mission). After Doyle joined their group, they continued their raid in order to blow up a train bridge, vital to the German war effort. However, he was shot by a German soldier while making his way to the bridge. He is never mentioned in the game again.

Private Vanya (Russian: Ваня) is a character featured in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. He was a Red Army soldier who fought in the Battle of Stalingrad during World War II. He worked with Pvt. Ianov and used a PPSh-41 as his weapon of choice.

The Vorkuta Guard is a prison guard and enemy NPC in Call of Duty: Black Ops. He appears in the level "Vorkuta" in the initial stages of the level, where he enters the workhouse to supervise the work of the prisoners. He finds prisoners Viktor Reznov and Alex Mason fighting, so he heads for Mason to beat him up, but soon turns his club towards Reznov when he insults him. While he is beating up Reznov with his club, Mason staggers to get up and hits him in the head with a rock, cracking his skull and instantly killing him. Reznov later takes his club and the keys to the elevator.

Victor H. Ramos is the tertiary antagonist in Call of Duty: Ghosts. He was a high-ranking officer in the Federation Science Division and was in charge of the covert operations outside No Man's Land and reverse engineering efforts to analyze the wreckage of the ODIN Space Station to build the LOKI Space Station in development.
Väst is a character in V.E.R.S.I.O.N.. He is the transhuman CEO of the Coalescence Corporation.
Victor "Gator" Diallo is a supporting character featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare.

Vice Admiral Vlad Derhachov is an antagonist in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare and member of the Settlement Defense Front. He is the commander of the SDS Hellas. He was tasked with deploying chemical weapons against UNSA forces. However, he was killed after his ship was destroyed in the atmosphere of Venus during the Retribution assault.
Commander Viktor Krushkin is a character in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. Krushkin is the leader of the Blood Anvil military group.

Corporal Venegas is a minor character in Call of Duty: WWII. He is one of the heroic action events. In the mission Hill 493, He is seen having a struggle with German soldier in a MG pillbox, when Daniels disables the German Tank. Ronald "Red" Daniels can choose to save him or not.
Wheeler is a character in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One. He is a part of Sgt. Hassler's squad and assists the player's squad in a mine-removal mission.

Private Whitney is a character in Call of Duty: United Offensive. He helps the player through Crossroads to Noville, and plays an important role in the Battle of Foy. He is armed with a M1 Garand. He is most likely good friends with Private Anderson.
Private Walton is a soldier that helps the player's squad push into the town of Bergstein. He is killed while clearing the German Headquarters.
Private Watson was a British soldier who fought during World War II as featured in Call of Duty.
Private Weckman is a U.S. Marine sniper that was part of the rescue team in the level "Hard Impact" in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare (Nintendo DS).
Captain Walcroft was a Canadian soldier, who served with the Calgary Highlanders. He was featured in Call of Duty: Roads to Victory.

Captain Weston is a United States Marine Infantryman in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare: Mobilized, and is the commanding officer of Warthog Squad. He appears in every USMC level and always uses an M4 Carbine.
Sergeant Watts is a character appearing in Call of Duty: Black Ops (Nintendo DS). He is seen in Killhouse when the player finishes the course.

Codename Watcher is a US Air Force pilot and a playable character in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance. The player controls Watcher in the mission Overwatch to watch over three British SFSG troops navigate their way to a suspected Russian weapons cache. Watcher guides the trio as they make their way to the cache. As soon as they reach the warehouse, the trio go inside to eliminate the Russians inside while Watcher maintains patrol.
Sergeant Waite was a soldier that appeared in Call of Duty: Roads to Victory.
Wendy is a character briefly appearing at the beginning cutscene of "Utopia" in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. After the success of the hunt for Hades, she interviews Jonathan Irons.
Wei (威), also known as Granville or Salty by players, is a character featured in Call of Duty Online.
Gefreiter Walter Gerber is a minor character featured in the level Liberation in Call of Duty: WWII. His name is stated by a Gestapo officer.

Lieutenant Wade Jackson is one of the four playable protagonists and Operator featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard. Wade appears in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added on February 28th, 2024, during Season 2: Lunar Dragon as part of the Dynastic Steel Lucky Box.

Private Yuri Petrenko (Russian: Юрий Петренко) was a Russian soldier in Call of Duty: United Offensive, and one of three playable characters in the game. He was initially conscripted into the 67th Guards Rifle Division, where he first saw combat in the Battle of Kursk. It was there that he served in a squad under the command of Sergeant Antonov, and with his comrades Miesha Korolov, Vassili Kulikov, and Semashko.

Senior Sergeant Yakov Fedotovich Pavlov (Russian: Я́ков Федо́тович Па́влов) is a Russian soldier who fought to defend an apartment building, now named "Pavlov's House". In the game, his squad clears it out and holds it against German reinforcements for no more than twenty minutes.
Colonel Young was an American officer assigned to the 82nd Airborne Division who fought in World War II, as featured in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One.
Private Wilson was a soldier assigned to the 1st Infantry Division during Operation: Torch. He only appears in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One.
Private Winneswi was a character appearing in Call of Duty 3.

Captain Wojick (abbreviated Capt. Wojick in game) is a soldier that is seen in the level First to Fight on Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare (Nintendo DS). He briefs the player and sends them to weapons training, where he then disappears after meeting the first instructor.
Sergeant Yuri Raslov is a Soviet Russian playable character and an NPC in Call of Duty: Black Ops (Nintendo DS).
Sergeant First Class William James Bennet is the main protagonist featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops Mobile. He is the main playable character.
Corporal Williams was a Canadian soldier who appeared in Call of Duty 3, he was a part of Lt. Jean-Guy Robiechauld's squad during World War II.

Lance Corporal William "Will" Robert Irons is a minor character in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. He is the son of Jonathan Irons and is Jack Mitchell's best friend. Will solely appears in the level "Induction".

Colonel Winston Harker is a character featured in Call of Duty Online. He is a former member of Task Force 141 who later returned to the organization as a consultant. Initially serving as a commanding officer and ally to the task force, Harker is later revealed to be commanding Shadow Company and overseeing the production of dirty bombs using Element 115 and Nova 6, becoming one of the main antagonists of the campaign.

Private Yudin is a character who appears in Call of Duty: World at War (Nintendo DS). He is seen to be injured in the mission On the Run, where Corporal Dimarkurato has to administer First Aid. He implores for the player not to abandon him, but is seen again alive at the end of the level.
Xiao is a Chinese PLA operative in Call of Duty: Strike Team. He assists the JSOC in recovering the stolen data in the rooftop slums in Hong Kong and is briefly playable in the Kowloon campaign.
Private William George is a character in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. He appears in the level Come Out Fighting, participating in the attack on Tillet as a member of Sam Rivers' tank crew.
Technical Sergeant William Pierson is the tritagonist in Call of Duty: WWII, with an active skill to highlight enemies.
Private Willis is a minor character in Call of Duty: WWII. He is a soldier who overlooks the artillery fire on Hill 493.

Wraith is an enemy that appears in the Zombies mode of Call of Duty: Black Ops 4 and Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War. It is a Zombified Elephant, like the Fury, and is the Venerated Warrior, or Champion of the Nine. In Black Ops 4, it appears as the first boss in the map IX and in Black Ops Cold War, it appears in Dead Ops Arcade 3: Rise of the Mamaback.

Yu Chen, also known as Shadowfall, is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on February 3rd, 2023, during Season 1: Awakening as part of the Dragon Fire Draw. Shadowfall also appears in the comics.

William Ansel is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile. Mentioned several times by Dietrich Ansel, William Ansel first appeared in the Season 2: Heavy Metal comics within a simulation created by the Iron Will
Wu Ming is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile. He was added in October 2024 during Season 9: Orbital Raiders as part of the Last Voyage Draw.
Xie Chang'an (谢长安), also known as Wuchange (无常鬼), is a character featured in Call of Duty Online.

Baby Monkey is the unofficial mascot of Easy Difficulty since Bloons TD 4. They also appear in Bloons Card Storm as a harmless monkey, who is only the transmutated product of the card "Shrink". Baby Monkey usually appears with a pacifier and a baby bonnet, except in Bloons Card Storm, who instead has just a pacifier and sleeps in a banana cradle with a blanket. Baby Monkey may represent many variants of unnamed infant monkey characters, and Ninja Kiwi confirms that not all of them represent the same character.
Billy is an Epic Ally in Bloons Adventure Time TD, first introduced in Version 1.1. He throws axes with high pierce and high damage at bloons.

Bloon Princess is a non-playable character from Bloons Adventure Time TD. She is a sentient Bloon who was Ice King's former girlfriend at the time of her life. She is killed by Finn, who pops her. For more info about her storyline, refer to Winter is Coming#Quotes.

Doctor Monkey is a major character in Bloons Supermonkey 2 Mobile. Initially serving as a supporting character, he is the researcher and builder of various weapons for Super Monkey's arsenal. He can perform red and blue blop research after completing Level TBA. He becomes an unlockable playable character in Bloons Super Monkey 2 Mobile after clearing all the stages in Helium Heights.

Grand Master Wizard is a non-playable character from Bloons Adventure Time TD. He is a giant white wizard who is the host of the Wizard Battle. In Mystery Doors and Wizard Royale, he appears in the middle of the north section of seats. For more info about his storyline, refer to Wizard Battle#Quotes.

Hunter Marceline (nicknamed Hunter Marcy) is a premium character in Bloons Adventure Time TD and is a path-based moving counterpart of Marceline. She costs $950 in the game and throws seeking stakes at Bloons like a Monkey Ace with Neva-Miss Targeting. Unlike the Monkey Ace, she does not shoot multiple projectiles around herself, instead she rapidly throws stakes at bloons, just like the forward firing attack from planes from Aircraft Carrier, except that instead of only throwing projectiles when she is facing bloons, she always throws projectiles when bloons are on screen. She is unlockable with a one-off purchase of $9.99 USD or 75,000 Martian Crystals in the Martian Trader.

Mayor Monkey is a non-playable character who first appears in Bloons Pop!. His job is to run as the mayor of the Monkey Town. He appears to be very open in how he expresses emotion, exciting himself in the littlest of events. He wears stereotypical mayor clothing, wearing a top hat, monocle, and a formal suit with a red bow tie, and has a brown "capitalist" mustache and receding brown hair. Mayor Monkey also enjoys advertising the Auto Fast Forward every so often. Mayor Monkey also appears in BTD Battles 2 appearing in 3 Monkey Mastery cosmetics for the Monkey Village which are Campfire, Mayoral Greetings and Moving on.

Monkey King (or King Monkey) is a non-playable character who appears in Bloons Monkey City Flash and Bloons Monkey City Mobile. He makes a significant appearance in the Mobile version, and sometimes shows up in place of Army Monkey to give the player tips. In the Flash version, he merely makes appearance in the leveling up screen and the Legendary "Monkey Business" Monkey Knowledge card. He seems much friendlier and care-free in BMC Mobile, and less serious compared to his BMC Flash counterpart. Monkey King also makes appearance in Bloons TD 6, exclusive to Contested Territory as a cosmetic item obtainable via the Team Store.

Monkey Baron is a non-playable character and main antagonist of Hot Air Bloon iOS. He kidnaps the Monkey Princess, takes her into his blimp and flies off. He is also the final boss of Level 7, in a chase sequence involving the Blimp Monkey chasing the Monkey Baron to reach the castle before the Monkey Baron does. In the end of the gameplay story, he is defeated by being left behind from the blimp that he used to kidnap her, all because of Classic Dart Monkey's epic journey to save her. His lair appears to be a medieval-style castle. At the end of the game, it is revealed that the Monkey Baron is the Player Monkey's brother.

Quest Monkey (a.k.a. Mail Monkey) is a non-playable character who appears in several games, first appearing in BTD5. Their role differs in each game. Their name was confirmed on Ninja Kiwi's [https://ninjakiwi.com/blog/news/173464-what-s-up-at-ninja-kiwi-4th-february-2022 4th February 2022 blog].

Rogue Monkey is the player's main character in Rogue Legends. He wears a red scarf, similarly to the Beast Handler, and holds his signature torch on his left hand to guide the way across dark regions of land that he explores. Unlike most Monkey characters, Rogue Monkey has thick beady eyes (rather than large white eyes with "Pac-Man" pupils) and a v-shaped mouth. He is tasked to complete quests around various terrains around the island. He also appears during the Rogue Legends game over screen when failing a Bloon tile, where he closes his eyes in disappointment and feels a little dizzy.
Aho'eitu is a playable leader in Paradise Found. He is a reused Montezuma. 'Aho'eitu leads the Tongans and supposedly lived in the 10th century.

Abraham Lincoln (February 12, 1809 – April 15, 1865) was the 16th President of the United States and led the country through its American Civil War. He leads the Americans in Sid Meier's Civilization. Normal Development Total threat level: 1 Musical Theme Inspiration: Battle Hymn of the Republic
Adam Adamandy Kochański is a in the Jadwiga's Legacy scenario in Civilization VI.
Abdul Hamid II is a playable leader from the Scramble for Africa scenario in Civilization V: Brave New World. He leads the Ottomans. He is a reused Suleiman.
(or Mvemba a Nzinga) is a Kongolese leader in the Civilization games and a Bantu leader in the Call to Power games.

Abu Tamim Ma'ad al-Mu'izz li-Din Allah (26 September 932 – 19 December 975) was the fourth Fatimid caliph and the 14th Ismaili imam, reigning from 953 to 975. It was during his caliphate that the center of power of the Fatimid dynasty was moved from Ifriqiya (modern Tunisia) to Egypt. A reused , he leads the s in scenario in Civilization III: Conquests.
Alexander the Great (20/21 July 356 – 10/11 June 323 BC) was King of Macedon (r. 336 – 323 BC) and creator of one of the largest empires in history. He leads the Greeks in Civilization IV.

, also known as Alexander III, is a Greek and Macedonian leader, Great Person, and unit in the Civilization and Call to Power games and the son of Philip II of Macedon and Olympias. He appears in every game in the main series, including both Civilization Revolution games.
is a Belgian leader in the Civilization games and the nephew of Leopold II. To date, he has appeared only in scenarios.
Alarich I or Alaric I (c. 370 – 411 AD) was the first king of the Visigoths, from 395 to 410. A reused , he leads the s in the scenario in Civilization III: Conquests.
al-Zahrawi refers to Abu al-Qasim al-Zahrawi, also known as Albucasis or Abulcasis, a Great Person in the Civilization games.

Andy Brick (born June 8, 1965) is an American composer, conductor, and symphonist. He is known for conducting the Prague Filmharmonic Orchestra, which performed the soundtrack for Civilization V and its Gods & Kings and Brave New World expansions. He also conducted the orchestras that performed the soundtracks for Sid Meier's Civilization: Beyond Earth and its Rising Tide expansion, Civilization VI, and Civilization VII. As of October 2021, Brick is a Distinguished Associate Professor and head of the Music and Technology department at Stevens Institute of Technology in Hoboken, New Jersey.
Ashurbanipal (685 BC – 627 BC) was an Assyrian king, the son of Esarhaddon and the last strong king of the Neo-Assyrian Empire. He leads the Assyrians in Civilization V: Brave New World.
Asoka, or Ashoka (c. 304 – 232 BC), was an Indian emperor of the Mauryan Dynasty who ruled from c. 269 to 232 BC. He leads the Indians in Civilization IV.

Augustus Caesar (23 September 63 BC – 19 August 14 AD) is considered the first emperor of the Roman Empire, though he himself insisted upon the title of Princeps Civitatis ("first among the citizens") and at least in theory was invested with all of his power by the Senate. He leads the Romans in Civilization IV: Warlords.
, also known as Atilla, is a Hunnic leader in the Civilization games and a Barbarian leader in the Call to Power games.
The BEF is a non-playable leader from the War Machine scenario in Civilization VI: Gathering Storm. It leads the British and has no leader ability.

Basil II (c. 958 – 15 December 1025), nicknamed the Bulgar-Slayer for his subjugation of the Bulgars, was the senior Byzantine emperor from 976 to his death. His 49-year reign, the longest of any Byzantine emperor, is considered the pinnacle of Byzantine power during the Middle Ages. He leads the Byzantines in Civilization VI. Byzantium combines religious and military tactics towards a Domination or Religious Victory.
Badher Belhachemi is a voice actor who speaks Moroccan Arabic. He provided the voice of Ahmad al-Mansur in Civilization V: Brave New World.
Otto von Bismarck (1 April 1815 – 30 July 1898) was a Prussian statesman and the first Chancellor of Germany. He leads the Germans in Civilization IV.

Bill Spieth, sometimes credited as William Spieth, is an American computer game designer who founded Frog City Software with his brother Ted Spieth and Rachel Bernstein. He is known for designing Imperialism and Imperialism II: The Age of Exploration, as well as Trade Empires and Tropico 2: Pirate Cove.
Beth Goddard (born March 31, 1969) is a British voice actress who speaks British English. She provided the voice of Elizabeth I in Civilization VI: Leader Pass.

Boudica was the queen of the Iceni tribe of Britain until her death in either 60 or 61 AD. She led a failed uprising against the forces of the Roman Empire. She leads the Celts in Civilization IV: Beyond the Sword.

Brennus (d. 279 BC) was one of the leaders of the Gallic invasion of the Balkans. Little is known about him other than that he led the Gauls at the and the attack on Delphi in 279 BC. He leads the Celts in Civilization IV: Warlords.
Boudicca (or Boudica) was leader of the British Iceni tribe who led an uprising against Roman forces in Britain in 60 or 61 AD. She leads the Celts in Civilization V: Gods & Kings.

Bruce Shelley (born July 1948), sometimes credited as Bruce Campbell Shelley, is an American computer game designer. He helped design Sid Meier's Civilization and Railroad Tycoon with MicroProse, and is also known for helping design board games with Avalon Hill.
(or Börte) is a Mongolian leader in the Civilization and Call to Power games, the wife of Genghis Khan, the mother of Ögedei Khan, and the grandmother of Kublai Khan and Möngke Khan.

Gaius Julius Caesar (12 July 100 BC – 15 March 44 BC) was a Roman general and statesman. He leads the Romans in Sid Meier's Civilization. Normal Aggression Total Threat Level: 3 Musical Theme Inspiration: Augustus Rises (original composition)
Suzanne Fielding leads the American Reclamation Corporation.
Cambyses II is a non-playable leader from the Gifts of the Nile scenario in Civilization VI. A reused Gandhi, he leads the Persians and has no leader ability.
Catherine the Great (2 May 1729 – 17 November 1796) was Empress of Russia (1762 – 1796) after her husband's assassination. She leads the Russians in Civilization IV.

Casimir III the Great (30 April 1310 – 5 November 1370), known as Kazimierz Wielki in Polish, was the last monarch of Poland from the Piast dynasty. He leads the Poles in Civilization V: Brave New World.

Catherine de Medici (13 April 1519 – 5 January 1589) was an Italian noblewoman who was queen consort of France to king Henry II from 1547 until 1559, and queen mother to three different kings from 1559 until her death, a period during which she exerted enormous influence over the French throne. She leads the French in Civilization VI. Although nominally a cultural player, France is a dangerous opponent. Catherine will be aware of what you are up to, and will be able to use Spies and her potent Industrial era army to protect her interests. Casimir I the Restorer (25 July 1016 – 19 March 1058), a member of the Piast dynasty, was the duke of Poland from 1040 until his death. A reused , he leads the Poles in scenario in Civilization III: Conquests.
Charlemagne (c. April 742 – 28 January 814) was King of the Franks from 768 and Emperor of the Romans from 800 until his death. He leads the Holy Romans in Civilization IV: Beyond the Sword.

Chandragupta Maurya (340 – 293 BC) was the founder of the Maurya Empire, the first empire to unite most of Ancient India, over which he reigned from 321 to 297 BC, when he abdicated the throne to his son Bindusara and allegedly became an ascetic Jain monk until his death. He leads the Indians in Civilization VI: Rise and Fall. Chandragupta represents a less peaceful side of India, not afraid to be on the offense, expanding its borders into foreign lands.
Cetshwayo is a playable leader from the Scramble for Africa scenario in Civilization V: Brave New World. He leads the Zulus. He is a reused Shaka.

Ce Acatl Topiltzin, is a mythologised figure appearing in 16th-century accounts of Nahua historical traditions, where he is identified as a ruler in the 10th century of the Toltecs — by Aztec tradition their predecessors who had political control of the Valley of Mexico and surrounding region several centuries before the Aztecs themselves settled there. A reused , he leads the in scenario in Civilization III: Conquests.
Sir Winston Churchill (30 November 1874 – 24 January 1965) was the British prime minister during the Second World War. He leads the English in Civilization IV: Warlords.

Clancy Fernando is an Great Admiral in Civilization VI. His unit provides +5 Combat Strength and +1 to Information era naval units within 2 s. Clancy Fernando can be retired to grant a free level and +200% combat experience to a military naval ​.

Constantine I (27 February c. 272 – 22 May 337), also known as Constantine the Great, was Roman emperor from AD 306 to 337. He was the first emperor to convert to Christianity. A reused , he leads the Romans in the scenario in Civilization III: Conquests.

Cyrus the Great (c. 600/576 BC – 530 BC) was the founder of the Persian Empire under the Achaemenid Dynasty. He is famous for having united most of the Persian Empire under Persian rule during his lifetime. He leads the Persians in Civilization IV.
Charles de Gaulle (22 November 1890 – 9 November 1970) was a French general and statesman who led the Free French Forces during World War II. He leads the French in Civilization IV: Beyond the Sword.
Debater is a for the Apostle in Civilization VI and the Priest from the Path to Nirvana scenario.

Darius III is a non-playable leader from the Conquests of Alexander scenario in Civilization VI. He leads the Persians, and his leader ability is "Postal Service Qualification," which allows his Builders to build one extra tile improvement.
Darius III (c. 380 – 330 BC) was the last Achaemenid King of Kings of Persia, reigning from 336 BC to his death in 330 BC. A reused , he leads the Persians in scenario in Civilization III: Conquests.
Cyaxares (reigned 625–585 BCE) was the third king of the Medes. A reused Xerxes, he leads the Medes in the Mesopotamia scenario in Civilization III: Conquests.
Debra Wilson (born April 26, 1962) is an American voice actress who speaks American English. She provided the voice of Harriet Tubman in Civilization VII.
Dido, also known as Elissa, was the founder and first Queen of Carthage. She leads the Carthaginians in Civilization V: Gods & Kings.

Edward Teach or Thatch (c. 1680 – 22 November 1718), better known by his epithet Blackbeard, was an English pirate who operated around the and the eastern coast of the from 1716 until his death. His fearsome reputation and actions, most notably his blockade of , have made him an enduring symbol of the and an inspiration for the archetypal pirate in fiction. He is a leader in Civilization VII. He is available with the within the , which was released on November 4, 2025.
Elizabeth I (7 September 1533 – 24 March 1603) was the Queen of England from 1558 until her death. She leads the English in Civilization IV.
is an English leader and unit in the Civilization and Call to Power games and the daughter of Henry VIII. She appears in every game in the main series, including both Civilization Revolution games.

Enrico Dandolo (c. 1107 – May 1205) was the 41st Doge of Venice from 1192 until his death. Known for his blindness, piety, longevity, and shrewdness, he is often considered the most influential, yet controversial Doge in the history of Venice. He leads the Venetians in Civilization V: Brave New World.
Emperor Louis IV is a playable leader from The Black Death, a scenario in Civilization VI: Gathering Storm. He leads the Imperials and has no leader ability.

Ferdinand Magellan is one of the Sid Meier's Colonization Founding Fathers, from the Exploration category. With Magellan in the Congress, the movement allowance of all naval vessels is increased by one, and the time to sail from the west map edge to Europe is shortened considerably.
Frederick II (24 January 1712 – 17 August 1786) was King in Prussia (1740 – 1786). He leads the Germans in Civilization IV.
, also known as Frederick II, is a German leader in the Civilization and Call to Power games.
Frederick II is a German leader in the Civilization games and the grandson of Frederick Barbarossa.

Gajah Mada (c. 1290 AD – 1364 AD), translated as Elephant General, was a powerful military leader and mahapatih or prime minister of the Majapahit Empire, credited with bringing the empire to its peak of glory. He delivered an oath called Sumpah Palapa, in which he vowed not to enjoy the pleasures of the world until he had conquered all of the Southeast Asian archipelago of Nusantara for Majapahit. He leads the Indonesians in Civilization V: Brave New World.

Friedrich II (24 January 1712 – 17 August 1786), commonly known as Friedrich the Great, was from 1740 until his death. His innovative tactics, reorganization of the and turned Prussia into one of the foremost powers in Europe, while his administrative modernisation and patronage of science, education and the arts made him a leading example of the principles of . He is a leader in Civilization VII. This is one of Friedrich's two alternate personas, the other being Friedrich, Baroque.

Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi (2 October 1869 – 30 January 1948), better known by the honorific Mahatma (meaning "great soul"), was an Indian lawyer and activist. As the ideological leader of the Indian independence movement, he is considered the symbolic father of modern India. He leads the Indians in Civilization III.
Genghis Khan (c. 1162 – 1227) was the founder of the Mongol Empire. He leads the Mongolians in Civilization IV.
is a Hivan leader in the Civilization games. To date, he has appeared only in scenarios.
Hiram I was the Phoenician king of Tyre according to the Hebrew Bible. A reused Hannibal, he leads the Phoenicians in the Mesopotamia scenario in Civilization III: Conquests.

Martin Sheen (born August 3, 1940) is an American actor whose film career began in 1961, when he played the role of Packy Girard in Route 66. He narrated the official trailer for Civilization IV.

Empress Matilda (c. 7 February 1102 – 10 September 1167), also known as the Empress Maude, was one of the claimants to the English throne during the civil war known as the Anarchy. A reused , she leads the English in scenario in Civilization III: Conquests.
Mehmed II (30 March 1432 – 3 May 1481) was Sultan of the Ottoman Empire and notable for conquering Constantinople. He leads the Ottomans in Civilization IV: Warlords.

Menelik II (17 August 1844 – 12 December 1913), baptized as Sahle Maryam, was emperor of Ethiopia from 1889 until his death. Renowned for his expansion and modernization of Ethiopia, his victory in the First Italo-Ethiopian War secured Ethiopia's independence from European imperialism. He leads the Ethiopians in Civilization VI. Menelik founds cities on the hills, focusing on and letting his Council of Ministers boost his and with an eye towards a Religious or Culture Victory.
Michael VIII is a non-playable leader from the Rise of the Mongols scenario in Civilization V. He leads the Byzantines. He is a reused Alexander.
Michele Carli (born 1966) is an Italian voice actor who speaks Classical Latin. He provided the voice of Julius Caesar in Civilization VI.

Moksha, otherwise known as The Cardinal, is one of the s introduced in Civilization VI: Rise and Fall. He is in charge of religious activities, including defending and spreading his empire's religion and constructing religious infrastructure. __TOC__

Montezuma II (c. 1466 – June 1520) was the ninth ruler of the Aztec Empire. He leads the Aztecs in Civilization IV. Montezuma was killed during the Spanish conquest. According to the Spanish, he was killed by his own subjects; however, it is believed to be more likely that the Spanish murdered him after he served his purpose to them.
Mursili I was a king of the Hittites c. 1620-1590 BC. He leads the Hittites in Civilization III: Conquests.

Mvemba a Nzinga (c. 1456 – 1542 or 1543), baptized Afonso I, was the sixth manikongo of the Kingdom of Kongo, ruling from 1509 until his death. He is known for his conversion to Christianity and spread of the religion through his kingdom after the arrival of the Portuguese in Kongo, but also for his stern condemnation of the Portuguese slave trade in his many letters sent to kings Manuel I and João III. He leads the Kongolese in Civilization VI. Mvemba's Kongo is a land of apparent paradoxes: a religious civilization without generation or Holy Sites, and one that can grow to a huge Population in the middle of the Rainforest.

Nader Shah (August 1688 – 19 June 1747) was the founder and first shah of the Afsharid dynasty of Iran. His strategic brilliance and extensive military campaigns greatly expanded the Iranian empire, which earned him epithets such as "the second Alexander" and "the Napoleon of Persia." He leads the Persians in Civilization VI. Fight opposing Civilizations with Nader Shah’s combat bonus against full Health units and bask in the wealth from Persia’s Domestic s.

Natasha Loring (born April 14) is a South African actress whose film career began in 2008, when she played the role of Julie Saunders in Hitchhiker. She provided the voice of the advisor in Civilization VI and narrated the Diplomatic Victory movie in Gathering Storm.

Nancy Linari (born January 14, 1955) is an American actress and voice actress whose film career began in 1983, when she played the role of a reporter in Uncommon Valor. She provided the voice of the Economic Advisor in Civilization V.

Nebuchadnezzar II (c. 634 BC – 562 BC) was the son of Nabopolassar, the Chaldean restorer of Babylonian independence. Nebuchadnezzar is the most important king of the Second Babylonian or Neo-Babylonian Empire. He leads the Babylonians in Civilization V.
Nebuchadnezzar is a Great Person in Civilization Revolution.
Oda Nobunaga (23 June 1534 – 21 June 1582) was the initiator of the unification of Japan under the rule of the Shogun. He leads the Japanese in Civilization V.
